name: Sered
title: Son of Zebulun
summary: Sered was the firstborn son of Zebulun, who was one of Jacob's twelve sons. He is mentioned in the genealogies as one of those who traveled with Jacob to Egypt. Sered became the ancestor of the clan of the Seredites within the tribe of Zebulun.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Jacob's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Sered is listed as the first of Zebulun's three sons in the list of Jacob's descendants who traveled to Egypt.

keyEvents.title: The Journey to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Sered was among the 70 members of Jacob's family who went down to Egypt during the famine, where Joseph already held a position of power.

keyEvents.title: Ancestor of the clan of the Seredites
keyEvents.description: In the census on the plains of Moab, Sered's descendants were registered as the clan of the Seredites within the tribe of Zebulun.

keyEvents.title: Zebulun's Sons in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Zebulun's lineage, including Sered, is part of the genealogical records that confirm the origins of Israel's tribes.
